serverInfo.title: MolDraw Chemistry Tools
serverInfo.description: Read-only discovery for MolDraw chemistry drawing, converters, calculators, and 3D structure APIs.

instructions: Use read-only tools to look up MolDraw pages, chemistry converters, and generate 3D structures from SMILES. The in-app AI assistant requires a user-supplied Gemini API key; see https://www.moldraw.com/pages/ai-help.html.
